# cloudsmith_repository_connected_list (Data Source)

The `cloudsmith_repository_connected_list` data source returns all connected repositories configured for a given source repository.

By default, each source repository has a soft limit of 5 connected repositories. Contact Cloudsmith support if you need this limit increased.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_repository_connected_list" "connections" {
  namespace  = "my-organization"
  repository = "source-repo"
}

output "connected_repositories" {
  value = data.cloudsmith_repository_connected_list.connections.connected_repositories
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Organization to which the source Repository belongs.
- `repository` (String) Source Repository whose connected repositories are listed.

### Read-Only

- `connected_repositories` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connected_repositories))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--connected_repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connected_repositories`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean)

- `slug_perm` (String)
- `target_repository` (String)
